name: Osaka
blurb: Recent discussions highlight Osaka as a destination for dining, shopping, and landmarks like Osaka Castle, alongside transit connections to Tokyo and Kyoto. Visitors also note practical challenges such as busy train stations and local housing or noise regulations.

positive: Praise for local specialties like okonomiyaki and Wagyu bowls
Enjoyment of shopping and exploring Osaka Castle
Appreciation for convenient connections via Osaka station
negative: Complaints about long daily commutes between Osaka and Kyoto
Frustration with crowded stations and confusing train lines
Concerns regarding tightening rules for private lodgings and apartment noise

quotes.text: if we ever go back I need to make sure we spend a whole week in Osaka because that okonomiyaki was maybe the greatest food I've had in my life. it's so fucking good....

Hotel has an ice dispenser and as a chronic ‘chomps on ice when anxious’ person this is just what I needed after a long, overwhelming day 😭 love how much is connected with Osaka station but woooooow it was busy

Part of the biggest problem is the commute: I work in Kyoto but live in Osaka, so that means 1.5 hours there and 1.5 hours back. 

An entire 3 hours of my day in transit. 

I have tried to work on the train (even writing fiction for myself!), but I’m just too tired

Omg they’re still not doing that? I remember all the different lines in Osaka lol it was so confusing. It’s bad enough with the STM, RTL, EXO, etc here but I thought that Japan would have figured out Zones and shit by now
